title: Moments of Random Coefficients in Short Panels
abstract: arXiv:2608.31085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study identification and estimation of moments of random coefficients in short linear panels, allowing the number of heterogeneous coefficients to exceed the number of equations observed for each unit. Under moment homogeneity, different regressor histories impose restrictions on the same moment vector. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for these restrictions to identify moments of a given order, stated in terms of the row spaces generated by the regressor support. The results show that moments may be identified even when the coefficients cannot be recovered for any individual, and, for two full-row-rank histories, give the exact loss of independent restrictions caused by overlap of their row spaces. When the support condition fails, we establish nonidentification in the maintained model and characterize the sharp identified set implied by these conditional moments. translated_title: 短面板中随机系数的矩
translated_abstract: 我们研究短线性面板中随机系数矩的识别与估计，允许异质性系数的数量超过每个单位所观测到的方程数量。在矩同质性条件下，不同的回归变量历史会对同一个矩向量施加限制。我们给出了这些限制能够识别给定阶数矩的充分必要条件，该条件以回归变量支撑所生成的行空间来表述。结果表明，即使无法为任何个体恢复系数，矩仍可能被识别；对于两个满行秩的历史，我们给出了其行空间重叠所导致的独立限制的确切损失。当支撑条件不成立时，我们证明了在维持模型下的不可识别性，并刻画了这些条件矩所隐含的尖锐识别集。在二阶情形下，识别集由 positi（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究短线性面板中随机系数矩的识别与估计，以回归变量支撑生成的行空间给出了矩识别的充分必要条件，并证明即使个体系数无法恢复，矩仍可能被识别。
en_tdlr: This paper studies identification and estimation of moments of random coefficients in short linear panels, providing necessary and sufficient conditions for moment identification in terms of the row spaces generated by regressor supports, and showing that moments may be identified even when individual coefficients cannot be recovered.
